description: This PHP test class verifies the formatting of purge times in the OrangeHRM system, specifically ensuring that the FormatWithPurgeTime class correctly formats DateTime objects to the date '2022-02-24', using a mocked DateTimeHelperService to simulate the current time.

classes.name: FormatWithPurgeTimeTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the FormatWithPurgeTime class's functionality in formatting DateTime objects for purge strategy.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by mocking the DateTimeHelperService to return a fixed current date and injecting it into the kernel services.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that FormatWithPurgeTime correctly formats current and null DateTime values to the date '2022-02-24'.
